d.seg: നിണക്ക് വരാമോ എന്നു ചോദിച്ചു ഞാന് പറഞ്ഞു വരാനെന്റെ വണ്ഡിക്കൂലിക്കു പോലുമ് കാശില്ല
d.tr: Asked if I can come, I said I don't even have money for vehicle fare
d.ctx: The user is recounting a story of how a lady from Bangalore asked him to visit her and he replied about not having travel money.
d.j: A story about someone proposing to meet in person, reported as past speech, so it is a non-violation.
